pkgmetadata.longdescription: jayofelony's fork of pwngrid, which implements the peer-to-peer protocol pwnagotchi units use to advertise themselves and exchange handshake metadata over a shared grid. Upstream evilsocket/pwngrid stopped at v1.10.3 in 2019; this fork is the one pwnagotchi actually talks to. Installs /usr/bin/pwngrid.
